features: version-bound quiz question_index and per-question ask button
current-report lexical passage retrieval before unlocated questions and through existing read tool
source links retain versions and navigate to report anchors, quiz questions, classroom scenes
explicit missing/stale location fallback without guessing

frontend.browser_backend: disposable test fixtures with deterministic answer provider

discovered_and_fixed.issue: On question switch, model used previous multiplication question despite new addition locator.
discovered_and_fixed.fix: Place authoritative current quiz reading data after history and immediately before user question; retain scope and budget.

limits: Finite sampled behavior, no all-model quality guarantee
Keyword retrieval, not embedding search; synonym-only questions can miss
Unsubmitted quiz draft answers are not automatically included
Old citations without a locator open the original resource without a jump
Historical versions must remain available; unavailable versions are not replaced
No image vision or memory expansion
